summary: Tested Laravel Bali Vision Tour app end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (29 tests) at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all public pages, booking/newsletter POST, admin auth (right/wrong password + unauth redirect), admin resource CRUD, bookings status/delete, settings, content reset, and image upload — all 29 pass. Frontend Playwright verified: homepage renders (hero/navbar/footer/tour cards), newsletter submits with toast, hero search navigates, tour detail booking dialog opens and POST /booking returns 201 with toast, activity and car card book buttons open the shared booking dialog, admin login (wrong pass shows login-error, correct login redirects to /admin), admin pages (bookings, settings, content, tours) all render with expected data-testids.

critical.issue: ResourceController::payload() explicitly writes null for optional text/number fields (price_unit, badge, image, subtitle, etc.) which triggers SQLSTATE 23000 'Column X cannot be null' when the admin form is saved without those fields, even though the migrations declare DB-level defaults. Reproduced: create tour with only title+price+category returns HTTP 500 (see /app/laravel/storage/logs/laravel.log). Fix: in payload() skip keys whose $data value is null so the DB defaults apply, OR read defaults from config/resources.php for default/text/lines/json field types (currently only 'number' has defaults). Impacts any admin user who leaves optional fields blank.

ui_bugs.component: car card / activity card book buttons
ui_bugs.issue: Buttons use data-testid='car-book-{slug}' and 'activity-book-{slug}', not the documented 'book-car-btn' / 'book-activity-btn'. They function correctly (dialog opens) but naming diverges from the review spec — either update the spec or add alias testids for automation.

issues: Tailwind Play CDN warning in console ('cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production') — acceptable for MVP but should switch to compiled Tailwind for prod.
Lucide icons for 'instagram', 'facebook', 'youtube' not found in the loaded icon set (console warnings on every page); social icons in footer render as blanks.

action_items: Fix ResourceController::payload() so it doesn't submit NULL for text fields with DB defaults (price_unit, badge, image, etc.) — otherwise creating/editing any tour/car/activity/article without filling every optional field returns 500.
Register or import the missing Lucide icons (instagram, facebook, youtube) so footer social icons render.
Optional: add data-testid='book-car-btn'/'book-activity-btn' aliases to match the review spec, or update spec to the actual per-slug testids.

Environment note: during this run the container was restarted mid-test — MariaDB lost the bvt user/DB and Laravel storage was reset. Testing agent recreated user 'bvt'@'localhost'/'127.0.0.1'/'%', ran php artisan migrate --force and db:seed --force to restore 9 tours / 6 cars / 9 activities / 7 articles. Main agent should verify the seeder + migrations are idempotent across container restarts and possibly persist MariaDB grants via a startup script.
critical_code_review_comments: ResourceController.php line 104: `$data[$key] = ($val === '' ? null : $val);` unconditionally writes null for blank text inputs; this ignores DB column defaults and breaks CRUD when optional fields are empty.
SiteController::booking() has no rate limiting — anyone can spam the endpoint (only CSRF-token gated). Consider throttle middleware.
Booking dialog accepts date via native <input type=date> which is fine, but there is no server-side check that date >= today (only client `min` attribute).
seed_data_creation: Recreated MySQL user 'bvt' (host localhost/127.0.0.1/%) with pass bvt_secret_2026 after container restart wiped auth, then ran `php artisan migrate --force && php artisan db:seed --force` in /app/laravel to restore all seed data. Test data (TEST_% rows in tours/bookings/newsletter_subscribers) cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts=''` (must override -n from pytest.ini). All 29 pass on a healthy env. Public URL: https://bali-vision-tour-1.preview.emergentagent.com. If tests return HTTP 500 on admin create/update, verify the ResourceController payload fix landed; if pages 404 or DB empty, check `supervisorctl status mariadb laravel` and re-run migrate+seed. Tour/car/activity/article book flows use per-slug testids (car-book-{slug}, activity-book-{slug}) rather than the generic book-car-btn/book-activity-btn from the spec.
rca of the issue: Bug RCA — Admin CRUD 500 on optional-field submit: ResourceController.php's payload() default branch (line ~104) converts empty strings to null and writes them into `$data`. When the resulting associative array is passed to Model::create() / $item->update(), Eloquent generates an INSERT/UPDATE that includes every filled attribute with an explicit `?` bind — including nulls. Since columns like `price_unit` (varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Person'), `badge`, `image`, `subtitle`, `original_price` are NOT NULL at the DB level, MySQL rejects the write with SQLSTATE 23000. Reproduction: log in as admin, go to /admin/tours/create, fill only title + price + category + days, submit -> HTTP 500. Mitigation: in payload(), for text/lines/json/default field types, either (a) unset the key when value is null so the DB default is used, or (b) look up a per-field default from config/resources.php and substitute it, similar to the 'number' branch that already handles days/rating/reviews/price.
